newsitem.title: CHINA: Deng film fest falls flat in China's capital.
newsitem.headline: Deng film fest falls flat in China's capital.

text.p: Beijing movie theatres have postponed a festival of films on the life of Deng Xiaoping after two nights of dismal ticket sales, theatre managers said on Saturday.

The city's theatres originally announced that from February 20 to 25, every screen in the capital would be devoted to rolling over six movies about Deng, who died on Wednesday after serving as China's supreme leader for almost two decades.
On Saturday, however, managers at several theatres said they were temporarily taking Deng off their marquees in the face of poor customer response to tales of his revolutionary exploits.

"We sold one ticket," one manager said, noting that the same films -- government-produced propaganda blockbusters such as "Decisive Battles" -- had been running almost continuously on television since Deng's death was announced.
Another manager said his theatre would simply close until February 26, the day after Deng's official funeral is held in Beijing.
"Then we can start showing some other movies," he said.
